newsitem.title: USA: ValuJet announces new companion sale.
newsitem.headline: ValuJet announces new companion sale.

text.p: ValuJet Inc announced a new sale on Wednesday allowing passengers who pay a regular fare and travel before June 2 to take a companion along for free.
The discount carrier said customers who take advantage of the offer could also earn credit for a second companion fare by purchasing another regular fare for travel between June 3 and November 9.
ValuJet was set to begin service to Charlotte, N.C., and Flint, Mich., on Thursday. The two new routes would give the Atlanta-based airline 172 peak daily departures to 24 markets.
